#### How can you dispute the debt?

-   **Call or write to us by August 28, 2020, to dispute all or part of the debt.** If you do not, we will assume that our information is correct.
-   **If you write to us by August 28, 2020**, we must stop collection on any amount you dispute until we send you information that shows you owe the debt. You may use the form below or write to us without the form. You may also include supporting documents. We accept disputes electronically at [www.example.com/dispute.](http://www.example.com/dispute)

#### What else can you do?

-   **Write to ask for the name and address of the original creditor, if different from the current creditor.** If you write by August 28, 2020, we must stop collection until we send you that information. You may use the form below or write to us without the form. We accept such requests electronically at [www.example.com/request.](http://www.example.com/request)
-   **Go to** [**www.cfpb.gov/debt-collection**](http://www.cfpb.gov/debt-collection) **to learn more about your rights under federal law.** For instance, you have the right to stop or limit how we contact you.
-   Contact us about your payment options.
-   Póngase en contacto con nosotros para solicitar una copia de este formulario en español.
